scores.name: Hashiya Folio
scores.note: Strongest Sharjah grounding in the set (World Book Capital, Bulaq naskh). Sustainability ledger feels appended. Marginalia needs explaining in five minutes.

scores.name: Gypsum Hour
scores.note: Handsome but generic warm minimalism; one caption line cannot carry the theme. Depends on photography the team has not shot yet.

scores.name: Lagoon After Dark
scores.note: Off-peak night visiting is a real Gulf-heat lever. Projector-proof. Magenta must stay civic or SCTDA reads nightlife; night-only limits reach.

scores.name: Girih Screen
scores.note: Teal and brass lattice is the default AI Arabian-luxury look despite guardrails. Mask animation and three sheet states exceed seven hours.

scores.name: Mleiha Field Sheet
scores.note: Carbon ledger and protected-site stamps are explicit, but stamps read as last year's badges. Visually a twin of Khor Field Guide.

scores.name: Coral Reticle
scores.note: Glass HUD with corner ticks over a camera is the canonical AI AR mockup. Sharjah survives only as color names. Carbon row is good.

scores.name: Route Band Signage
scores.note: Reads like something SCTDA would install on the Corniche. Footprint bands make sustainability legible without a leaf icon. Flat CSS, buildable today.

scores.name: Khor Field Guide
scores.note: Best theme fit (capacity meters, EPAA credits), but green-for-sustainability is the obvious move and illustration plates will not finish by tomorrow noon.
